ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Traces
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Event traces: the signs that something happened here - blaster scars on walls, bolt pits, crawl and drag trails, breached doorways, drifted sand and dust film in abandoned rooms, mend plates and soot rings. Design: design/RimMandrake/event_trace_props_library_design_2026-10-03.md (EVENT_TRACE_PROPS_LIBRARY_1).
STEP 0 SPIKE ONLY (build plan §8): two placeholder filth defs on vanilla textures, no C#, no art. RM_Trace_SpikeWall is a Carrier W filth (altitudeLayer BuildingOnTop, Graphic_ClusterTight) meant to be spawned ON a wall cell; RM_Trace_SpikeFloor is a directed Carrier F filth (Graphic_ClusterTight). The spike answers §2.2's three UNMEASUREDs - does a filth spawn on a wall cell, does it draw above the wall, can the clean job reach it - before any runtime or art is paid for. Not for players; do not ship this state.
